headline: Creative Newtech signs strategic brand license agreement with AT&T
hook: AT&T brand enters Indian tech infrastructure

modes.bear: Execution risks in scaling a complex tech infrastructure business could weigh on margins if brand adoption is slower than expected.
modes.bull: AT&T partnership gives Creative Newtech instant global brand credibility to scale its new technology infrastructure business across multiple markets.
modes.simple: Creative Newtech can now use the well-known AT&T brand to sell tech infrastructure products in India and abroad, opening up a new potential income stream.

summary: Creative Newtech Limited has entered into a strategic brand license agreement with AT&T Intellectual Property to expand into technology infrastructure solutions across India and international markets. The partnership allows Creative Newtech to leverage the AT&T brand for infrastructure offerings. This expansion marks a major operational shift for the company into new product categories. Retail investors should watch how this new brand alliance impacts the company's revenue growth and market share in the technology infrastructure space.
why_it_matters: New brand partnership could drive long-term infrastructure revenue growth.
winners_losers: Creative Newtech gains / rivals face new competition

headline: Creative Newtech to hold EGM on November 28
hook: Extraordinary meeting scheduled for late November
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has issued a notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) of its shareholders. The meeting is scheduled to take place on November 28, 2026. Shareholders will convene to discuss and vote on specific corporate matters as outlined in the official notice. This is a routine corporate governance procedure for the company.
whats_next: November 28, 2026: Date of the Extraordinary General Meeting
why_it_matters: Shareholders may vote on key corporate decisions affecting company strategy.

headline: Creative Newtech acquires Zicom SaaS for Rs 50.5 crore
hook: Creative Newtech expands into managed security services
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has received board approval to acquire a 100% stake in Zicom SaaS Private Limited. The deal is valued at an enterprise value of approximately Rs 50.50 crore. This acquisition is intended to bolster the company's existing surveillance and managed security services portfolio. The move allows the company to integrate specialized SaaS security solutions into its current business offerings.
why_it_matters: Expansion into security SaaS may diversify the company's revenue streams.
winners_losers: Creative Newtech gains / Zicom SaaS shareholders exit

headline: Creative Newtech reports board meeting outcome
hook: Investors await details from Creative Newtech board
summary: Creative Newtech Limited filed a notice with the NSE announcing that its board meeting held on November 4, 2026 has concluded and the outcomes have been communicated to the exchange. The filing does not disclose the specific decisions taken at the meeting. The announcement satisfies regulatory compliance requirements for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding Creative Newtech shares may see price movement once the details are released.
why_it_matters: Share price may move after details emerge

headline: Creative Newtech releases investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 results
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has submitted its investor presentation detailing the financial results for the second quarter and half-year of FY27 to the stock exchange. The presentation provides a deeper look into the company's financial performance, operational metrics, and future outlook for the period. Retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap segment can review these slides to assess the company's margin trends and revenue growth.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings conference call if scheduled
why_it_matters: Quarterly presentation details company growth and margin trends

headline: Creative Newtech reports standalone and consolidated results for period ending September 30, 2026
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has submitted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance figures for the reported period. Retail investors can review these official numbers to assess the company's recent earnings growth and operational profitability.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the company's latest earnings trajectory.

headline: Creative Newtech says subsidiary Secure Connection won Rising Star Award for WOZOYO at Amazon event
hook: New award for subsidiary Secure Connection
summary: Creative Newtech Limited announced that its subsidiary, Secure Connection Limited, received the 'New Rising Star' award for the WOZOYO brand at the Amazon Ads Global Peak Season Ads Summit 2026. The recognition highlights the brand's performance in digital advertising and peak season sales. While positive for the subsidiary's market visibility, the development is routine corporate PR that has a negligible immediate impact on Creative Newtech's consolidated financials. Indian retail investors should note this is a promotional milestone rather than a material financial earnings catalyst.
why_it_matters: Promotional win for subsidiary lacks direct financial impact.
